details: Applying Assouad's bound to the dual class gives $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\leq2^{\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)+1}-1$. Thus, when VC dimension is positive, $\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\log_2\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Apply Assouad's theorem to $\mathcal H^*$ and use $(\mathcal H^*)^*=\mathcal H$ after identifying duplicate points. For positive $d=\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)$, the resulting logarithm is at most $d+1\leq2d$.
name: Dual VC Dimension / VC Dimension (logarithmic)
